rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose term for money deducted from a bank account.

example.english: There was another debit from my card this month.
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 zoeng1 kaat1 jau6 kau3 fun2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the debit side or an entry recorded on it in bookkeeping.

example.english: This amount should be recorded on the debit side.
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 sou3 jiu3 gei3 hai2 ze3 fong1
